footer: Demo data · NT Garage & Body Shop, Pune
title_footer: Recorded on the Android app · sample garage data

intro.title: From the gate to the bill
intro.subtitle: Job cards  ·  GST bills  ·  Estimates  ·  Staff & payroll  ·  Expenses
intro.say: NT Garage runs a car workshop from one phone: job cards, GST bills, estimates, staff and expenses. Let's walk through a day at the garage.

end.title: NT Garage
end.subtitle: Job cards · GST bills · PDF & WhatsApp · Estimates · Payroll · Marathi
end.say: NT Garage. Every car, every rupee, in one app.

clips.heading: Getting started
clips.tagline: Create the workshop account, add garage details and a price list
clips.say: Let's set up a new workshop.

steps.title: Welcome
steps.body: The app opens on the sign-in screen.
steps.say: The sign-in screen.

steps.title: Create the workshop account
steps.body: Owner name, garage name, email and password.
steps.say: The owner creates an account with the garage's name.

steps.title: Get set up
steps.body: A three-step checklist guides the first day.
steps.say: A short checklist guides the first day.

steps.title: Garage details
steps.body: Address, phone, GSTIN and UPI ID print on every bill.
steps.say: First, the garage details. The address, GSTIN and UPI ID print on every bill.

steps.title: GST rates and defaults
steps.body: Default GST rate, bill due days, delivery time and bill notes.
steps.say: GST rates and bill defaults are set here too.

steps.title: 1 of 3 done
steps.body: Garage details are ticked off.
steps.say: One step done.

steps.title: Price list
steps.body: Save common parts and labour once.
steps.say: Next, the price list.

steps.title: Add a part
steps.body: Name, category, price, unit and GST.
steps.say: Add a part with its price and GST rate,

steps.title: Add labour
steps.body: Labour items are priced per job.
steps.say: and a labour charge.

steps.title: Ready to pick
steps.body: These items are added to jobs in one tap.
steps.say: Now they can be added to any job with one tap.

clips.heading: A car comes in
clips.tagline: Find the car by its plate, open a job card, add parts and labour
clips.say: A car arrives at the gate.

steps.title: Today at the workshop
steps.body: Money collected, spent and due, and the cars in the workshop.
steps.say: Today at a glance.

steps.title: Start with the plate
steps.body: Type the registration number.
steps.say: A new job starts with the number plate.

steps.title: Returning car found
steps.body: The car comes with its owner and history.
steps.say: The car is found.

steps.title: Job card
steps.body: KM, fuel level, mechanic and promised delivery time.
steps.say: The job card opens with the kilometres filled in. Assign a mechanic,

steps.title: Complaints and inspection
steps.body: Note the complaints; Check all ticks the inspection.
steps.say: note the complaints, and tick the inspection checklist.

steps.title: Add parts and labour
steps.body: Pick from the price list; totals include GST.
steps.say: Parts and labour come from the price list, with GST included.

steps.title: Review and issue
steps.body: Four items on the job card.
steps.say: Review the items, and issue the job card.

steps.title: Job card JC-1004
steps.body: Status steps show where the job is.
steps.say: Job card issued.

steps.title: Ready for delivery
steps.body: Mark ready when the work is done.
steps.say: The car is ready for delivery.

clips.heading: Billing and payment
clips.tagline: GST bill from the job card, UPI payment, PDF and WhatsApp

steps.title: Create the bill
steps.body: One tap from the finished job card.
steps.say: One tap makes the bill.

steps.title: Tax invoice
steps.body: Garage GSTIN, customer, car and KM on the bill.
steps.say: It's a proper tax invoice with the garage's GSTIN,

steps.title: GST worked out
steps.body: CGST and SGST per rate, total, and a UPI QR to scan.
steps.say: GST worked out, with a UPI QR.

steps.title: Record payment
steps.body: Full or partial, by cash, UPI, card, bank or cheque.
steps.say: The customer pays by UPI.

steps.title: Payment received
steps.body: Nothing left to pay on this bill.
steps.say: Payment received.

steps.title: Bill settled
steps.body: Payment history shows on the bill.
steps.say: The bill is settled, with the payment on record.

steps.title: Share
steps.body: Send the PDF bill, or a WhatsApp message with the total.
steps.say: Share as PDF or WhatsApp.

steps.title: PDF bill
steps.body: The share sheet opens with the bill as a PDF.
steps.say: The PDF goes to WhatsApp, email or print.

clips.heading: Estimates
clips.tagline: Quote a price first, then turn the approved estimate into a job
clips.say: Some customers want a price first.

steps.title: Estimates
steps.body: Drafts, sent, approved and converted.
steps.say: Quotes before the work.

steps.title: Pick the customer
steps.body: Choose the customer and the car.
steps.say: Pick the customer and the car,

steps.title: Add items
steps.body: Two tyres at 28% GST and an alignment at 18%.
steps.say: and add two tyres and a wheel alignment.

steps.title: GST per rate
steps.body: Each rate gets its own CGST and SGST lines.
steps.say: Each GST rate gets its own lines.

steps.title: Estimate EST-1001
steps.body: Valid for 7 days; share it with the customer.
steps.say: The estimate is ready to share.

steps.title: Approve
steps.body: Mark it approved when the customer says yes.
steps.say: When the customer agrees, approve it,

steps.title: Converted to a job
steps.body: Items carry over to job card JC-1005.
steps.say: and convert it into a job card, with the items carried over.

clips.heading: Staff and payroll
clips.tagline: Attendance, advances and the monthly salary payout

steps.title: More
steps.body: Price list, estimates, expenses, staff and settings.
steps.say: Staff and payroll are under More.

steps.title: Staff
steps.body: Attendance and Salary on every row; mark all present in one tap.
steps.say: Every staff member has attendance and salary one tap away.

steps.title: Attendance
steps.body: Month calendar: present, half day, absent, leave.
steps.say: Attendance is kept on a monthly calendar.

steps.title: Payslip
steps.body: Half-day deduction and the advance are taken off.
steps.say: The payslip deducts half days and advances automatically.

steps.title: Confirm the payout
steps.body: Choose how it was paid: cash, UPI or bank.
steps.say: Paying salary asks for confirmation and the payment mode.

steps.title: Salary paid
steps.body: Recorded as an expense; it can't be paid twice.
steps.say: It's recorded as an expense, and can't be paid twice by mistake.

clips.heading: Expenses, team and Marathi
clips.tagline: Daily costs, subscription, team logins and the Marathi app
clips.say: Finally, the rest of the workshop.

steps.title: More
steps.body: Everything else lives here.
steps.say: Back to More.

steps.title: Expenses
steps.body: This month's and today's spending.
steps.say: Expenses shows what the workshop spends,

steps.title: Add an expense
steps.body: Category, title, amount, mode and a receipt photo.
steps.say: and a new tool purchase is added with its amount and a receipt photo.

steps.title: Totals update
steps.body: The new expense is at the top.
steps.say: The totals update straight away.

steps.title: Subscription
steps.body: 14-day free trial, then monthly or yearly.
steps.say: The subscription screen shows the free trial and plans.

steps.title: Team logins
steps.body: Invite staff with only the permissions they need.
steps.say: Team logins lets the owner invite staff with limited permissions.

steps.title: Marathi
steps.body: Switch the whole app to मराठी.
steps.say: Or switch to Marathi.

steps.title: मराठी होम
steps.body: Dashboard, jobs and statuses in Marathi.
steps.say: Built for garages across Maharashtra.
